name: skill-loop
description: Keep your own skills honest. Log what a skill got wrong the moment it happens, fix it from the queue with an approval gate, and know which other skills the fix puts at risk.

interface.shortDescription: The maintenance half of writing your own skills
interface.longDescription: Writing a skill is the easy part. Most of the work is noticing it did the wrong thing, remembering that a week later, and knowing what else breaks when you fix it. Skill Loop closes that loop. Log a correction the moment you spot it, work the queue when you have time, and get warned about dependent skills before you change anything. Every write is gated on your explicit approval, and fixes are committed so they can be reverted cleanly.
defaultPrompt: That was wrong, log it against the skill that did it.
What is in my skill bug queue?
Apply the oldest open fix in the queue.
Which skills depend on the one I am about to change?
